Title: User-Defined Product And Workflow Requirements
Content: User-specified requirements must be treated as durable constraints for implementation planning. Current active requirements: (1) avoid forced app restart/admin relaunch while other tests depend on the running instance, deferring auth runtime restart actions when disruptive; (2) improve sidebar visibility with wider panes where compressed; (3) use stacked layouts on narrow/mobile surfaces instead of unusably narrow side-by-side panes; (4) move toward GridSplitter-style draggable dividers across more multi-pane pages; (5) code-search status section must be collapsible, default collapsed, and auto-open on build state transitions; (6) parser strategy preference allows tree-sitter only if .NET coverage is truly sufficient, otherwise Roslyn plus tree-sitter is acceptable when Roslyn materially improves .NET quality/performance.
